input.summary: Insert Subparagraph 7.2A: our O&M commitment limited to successive 12-month periods from the RFS Date, reducible on 30 days' notice, with actual-cost true-up and no penalty or reclamation
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take a 25-year, uncapped O&M funding commitment with no exit, so we have added Subparagraph 7.2A limiting Teleglobe USA Inc.'s O&M Costs commitment to the then-current twelve (12) month period from the RFS Date, reducible on thirty (30) days' notice, with any reduction or shortfall settled by a true-up to O&M Costs actually incurred rather than any penalty, forfeiture, reclamation of capacity or acceleration.

ops.text: Teleglobe USA Inc.'s commitment to bear O&M Costs under Subparagraph 7.2 is limited to the then-current twelve (12) month period, such periods commencing on the RFS Date and each anniversary of it, and may be reduced by Teleglobe USA Inc. on thirty (30) days' prior written notice. On any such reduction or any shortfall against that commitment, Teleglobe USA Inc. shall pay only its proportionate share of O&M Costs actually incurred for the period concerned, trued up to actual cost, and no penalty, forfeiture, reclamation of capacity or acceleration shall apply in respect of the reduced amount.
